head: Wi-Fi and mobile data not working after One UI 9 update on some Galaxy phones
dek: Some Galaxy owners report Wi-Fi that keeps disconnecting, mobile data that won't connect, or a SIM card that isn't detected after the One UI 9 update. Samsung hasn't announced a fix.
details: Restarting or switching airplane mode on and off helps for a while. Some phones can't join 5 GHz Wi-Fi or one specific network, and one Galaxy Z Fold 7 owner lost Wi-Fi calling on T-Mobile. One user fixed it by turning off Wi-Fi 7 Mode under Developer options > Connectivity Labs, but others don't have that option.
where: Galaxy phones updated to One UI 9
means: If your Galaxy lost its connection after the update, you're not alone, and the update is the likely cause.
todo: Restart the phone or toggle airplane mode to get back online; install Samsung's next update when it arrives.
thumb_words: ONE UI 9 BREAKS WI-FI FOR SOME
